2  ORDER 14.11.2022 Heard Mr. S. Banik, learned counsel for the petitioner, who prays that the matter may be heard on 23.11.2022.
Issue notice, returnable in 9 (nine) days.
Mr. P.K. Sharma, learned counsel accepts notice on behalf on behalf of the respondent Nos. 2 to 4 and Mr. M. Chetia, learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of the respondent No. 1.
Petitioner to take steps for service of notice upon the respondent Nos. 5 & 6 by way of Dasti Service within a week and file affidavit of service thereafter.
List the matter on 23.11.2022.
Interim order passed earlier shall continue till the next returnable date.
